_data.title: MLI University and College Pathways Partners

university.title: University Agreements
university.description: Students who finish Mentor Language Institute's advanced-level classes can apply to these Bachelor's degree and Master's degree programs without TOEFL or IELTS upon completion of the university's approved language exam and meeting their academic qualifications.'

lists.title: Adelphi University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Adelphi fosters in its students a passion for knowledge, an understanding and questioning of cultural values and a view of themselves as independent, lifelong learners and contributors to knowledge and service in an ever-changing world.

lists.title: American University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: AU offers a broad and flexible choice of majors and minors. Students may double major, construct their own interdisciplinary major, or have their major in one school and a minor in another. AU encourages students to transcend the boundaries of academic disciplines.

lists.title: Auburn University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Auburn University is committed to preparing our students for today's global economy. The Office of International Programs site provides information on the international presence of Auburn University such as the Office of International Education, which provides International Student/Scholar immigration advising, study abroad options and more, information on initiatives sponsored by the academic units, and international admissions for undergraduate and graduate students.

lists.title: Floria International University
lists.description: Florida International welcomes students to a diverse, friendly community where industry connections and internship opportunities will help launch their career in a global marketplace. At FIU they’ll receive an outstanding education in an entrepreneurial city.

lists.title: Louisiana State University
lists.description: Earning an LSU degree is an investment in a student’s future. LSU offers an exceptional education and opportunities to have a fulfilling but affordable college experience.

lists.title: The University of Kansas
lists.description: A world of advanced scholarship, invention and discovery, KU provides an education that produces global leaders, business giants and visionaries in many fields, and an undergraduate student experience that will change their life.

lists.title: University of Central Florida
lists.description: Students have big dreams. Maybe they want to travel the world, run their own business or hold patents that help save lives. The University of Central Florida will help them get there.

lists.title: University of the Pacific
lists.description: University of the Pacific is located on a beautiful campus 1.5 hours from San Francisco. In addition to liberal arts, the University has schools of education, engineering and business, and graduate schools in dentistry, law, pharmacy and health sciences. The oldest chartered university in California, Pacific was first in the state to admit women.

lists.title: University of South Carolina
lists.description: The University of South Carolina is where students prepare to be tomorrow’s creative problem solvers who will lead future generations to a healthier, smarter and more vibrant way of life.

lists.title: University of Illinois at Chicago
lists.description: University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC) broadens educational opportunities for students from across the globe through an emphasis on diversity and providing students with an ethnically and culturally rich learning environment.

lists.title: The University of Utah
lists.description: The University of Utah is one of the best in the nation at creating startup companies based on student and faculty research. This is indicative of the innovative and industrious thinking found across campus and in classrooms.

lists.title: University of Dayton
lists.description: The University of Dayton is a top-tier national Catholic research university and the largest private university in Ohio. Founded in 1850 by the Society of Mary (Marianists), the University is characterized by the Marianist educational philosophy of learning in community, welcoming all, serving others, intellectual curiosity and academic rigor to foster servant-leaders who connect learning with leadership and service.

lists.title: UMass Amherst
lists.description: UMass Amherst is one of the major public research universities in America. Nestled in idyllic Amherst, Massachusetts, the campus is consistently ranked among the top public research universities in the nation, and offers a rich cultural environment in a rural setting close to major urban centers.

lists.title: University of Cincinnati
lists.description: With Cincinnati home to ten fortune 500 companies, the University of Cincinnati is a center for future achievers, leaders, and those with a thirst for knowledge. Ranked #135 in National Universities according to U.S. News & World Report, it boasts school spirit with a quarter-million bearcat alumni worldwide.

campus.title: College Agreements
campus.description: MLI has special agreements, or Mutual Recognition Programs (MRP), with many Los Angeles area colleges. These MRP agreements allow students to transfer without a TOEFL® score, and some also allow concurrent enrollment, which means MLI students can take part-time credit classes while still enrolled at MLI. Students must successfully complete MLI's high-intermediate program to be eligible.

lists.title: Santa Monica College
lists.description: Santa Monica College has transferred more students to the University of California campuses than any other college in the country—for 27  years straight. SMC also tops in transfers to UCLA, USC and Loyola Marymount University, and is the top feeder west of the Mississippi to the Ivy League Columbia University.

lists.title: Glendale Community College
lists.description: Glendale Community College is a dynamic institution with more than 25,000 students. They are enrolled in college-credit at the Verdugo Campus, continuing education at the Garfield Campus, community services classes held throughout the community, and the Professional Development Center (PDC) located in Montrose. The college serves an ethnically diverse student body with no single group forming a majority.

lists.title: Pasadena City College
lists.description: Pasadena City College provides the San Gabriel Valley with a high quality, innovative and dynamic learning environment that inspires student success. Each semester we offer academic programs that encompass degrees, transfer programs, and certificates, to 30,250+ students. We are new students and returning students. We are local, international, and online. We span many cultures — LGBT, multicultural, veterans, and everyone else in between.

lists.title: Cypress College
lists.description: Cypress College emphasizes education for the individual student. Excellence of instruction and individualized learning laboratories enhance the possibility for students to achieve their highest potential. In addition, a staff of tutors and full-time counselors provides instructional support and extensive guidance information to aid students in their choice of programs and classes. For the student who plans to complete a bachelors degree, the college provides a smooth transition from high school to colleges and universities.

lists.title: West Los Angeles College
lists.description: West Los Angeles College is an accredited California Community College offering paths to university transfer, career education and courses for personal or professional growth. It occupies 70 park-like acres overlooking Culver City, Marina Del Rey and Greater West Los Angeles. On a clear day, from the highest points on campus, you can see the Pacific Ocean. With an active student population of nearly 12,000 regular and extension students, our 110 full-time faculty, more than 300 hourly faculty and 112 classified staff create an educational environment unique in Southern California.

lists.title: El Camino College
lists.description:
Did you know El Camino College offers many outstanding features?
  • A leading Southern California transfer institution
  • Conveniently located and ample parking
  • Outstanding community education programs
  • Over 80 highly acclaimed career programs

lists.title: Pierce College
lists.description: Pierce College is a flourishing two-year public institution in Southern California providing opportunities for transfer education, occupational training, and life-long learning. Pierce combines academic excellence with a friendly and helpful faculty and staff. It has a solid reputation for being a student-friendly institution, offering students high-quality and challenging education that will prepare them for university or vocational work. Pierce students benefit from smaller class sizes and lower tuition than a four-year university.

lists.title: LATCC - Traning. Transfer. Tradition. Trade Tech.
lists.description: Mission Statement: Los Angeles Trade Technical College advances communities through pathways to academic, career, and transfer success that empower students to achieve career technical certificates, associate degrees, transfer, and employment. Our Vision: Los Angeles Trade Technical College will be a premier community college recognized regionally and nationally for transforming students’ lives and their communities.

lists.title: Los Angeles Harbor College
lists.description: Los Angeles Harbor College promotes access and student success through associate and transfer degrees, certificates, economic and workforce development, and basic skills instruction. Our educational  programs and support  services meet the needs of diverse communities as measured by campus institutional learning outcomes.

lists.title: New York Film Academy
lists.description: Over the past 25 years, the New York Film Academy (NYFA) has built a reputation as one of the premier visual and performing arts schools in the world. Our innovative programs are designed for a new generation of storytellers – for artists who share a passion for visual and performing arts, across a wide array of media and want to learn by doing. With an unrivaled approach to hands-on, interactive learning, students find themselves completely immersed in their course of study from day one. Classes are taught by award-winning industry professionals, in a real-world environment with state-of-the-art facilities and equipment.

lists.title: Los Angeles City College
lists.description:
LACC provides a dynamic and innovative learning environment offering more than 100 vocational and professional programs including degrees, transfer programs, and certificates to more than 18,000 students. In 2019, LACC will celebrate its 90th anniversary.
Under the LA College Promise, we offer one year of free enrollment to all full-time students graduating from LAUSD high schools and charter schools. We also offer music majors tuition free attendance, private lessons and financial aid thanks to a gift from The Herb Alpert Foundation. Additionally, our students benefit from a wide variety of financial aid options.

contactUs.title: Need More Information? Contact us
contactUs.description: Contact us by phone, email or via our social media channels.

category.title: Application Steps
content: If you have a valid U.S. visa , you don't have to get a new VISA. Bring your I-20 and vaild U.S. VISA and fly to the US.

Students are required to apply 1 or 2 months before desired starting date. It is best to speak with front desk staff after applying to confirm the application process as it can be complicated depending on your status.

category.title: Cancellation Policy
content: The enrollment fee of $150, will be charged at the time of application. The enrollment fee is non-refundable regardless if an application is rejected or enrollment is cancelled. Exceptions include insufficient housing.

category.title: About the steps after application

After students have applied, the iMLI system processes the application.
Students can follow the process which is listed on the iMLI.

Apply from below.

_data.pageTitle: MLI Universite et College Pathways partenaires | Mentor Language Institute
_data.pageDescription: Les étudiants qui terminent des cours avancés au Mentor Language Institute peuvent s'inscrire à ces programmes de premier cycle et des cycles supérieurs sans TOEFL ou IELTS à la fin de l'examen de langue approuvé par l'université et sous réserve de la vérification des qualifications académiques requises pour l'inscription.
_data.title: MLI Universite et College Pathways partenaires

university.title: Contrat Universitaire
university.description: Les étudiants qui terminent des cours avancés au Mentor Language Institute peuvent s'inscrire à ces programmes de premier cycle et des cycles supérieurs sans TOEFL ou IELTS à la fin de l'examen de langue approuvé par l'université et sous réserve de la vérification des qualifications académiques requises pour l'inscription.

lists.title: Adelphi University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Adelphi promeut auprès de ses étudiants la passion du savoir, la compréhension et le débat culturel ainsi que la vision d'eux-mêmes en tant que penseurs indépendants dans la recherche de connaissances au service dans un monde en constante évolution.

lists.title: American University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: L'UA offre un large choix de programmes d'études. Les étudiants peuvent étendre leur plan d’études et créer leur propre diplôme interdisciplinaire en choisissant différentes orientations. L'UA encourage les étudiants à dépasser les limites des disciplines académiques.

lists.title: Auburn University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: À l'Université Auburn, nous nous sommes engagés à préparer nos étudiants à l'économie mondiale d'aujourd'hui. Notre site Web de l’Office des programmes internationaux fournit des informations sur la présence internationale de l’Université d’Auburn, tandis que l’Office de l’éducation internationale fournit des conseils en matière d’immigration internationale à des fins d’étude, des options d’études à l’étranger, etc. parrainé par divers départements universitaires et admissions internationales pour les étudiants de premier cycle et des cycles supérieurs.

lists.title: Floria International University
lists.description: Florida International accueille les étudiants dans une communauté diversifiée et conviviale, où les relations et les opportunités de formation les aideront à démarrer leur carrière sur le marché mondial. À FIU, ils recevront une éducation exceptionnelle dans une ville entrepreneuriale.

lists.title: Louisiana State University
lists.description: L'obtention d'un diplôme de LSU est un investissement dans l'avenir d'un étudiant. LSU offre un enseignement exceptionnel ainsi que la possibilité de vivre une expérience universitaire satisfaisante et accessible.

lists.title: The University of Kansas
lists.description: Un monde de nombreuses bourses, inventions et découvertes avancées, KU propose une formation qui façonne les leaders mondiaux, les géants des affaires et les visionnaires dans de nombreux domaines, ainsi qu'une expérience universitaire qui changera leur vie.

lists.title: University of Central Florida
lists.description: Les étudiants ont de grands rêves. Peut-être veulent-ils découvrir le monde, gérer leur entreprise ou breveter des inventions qui peuvent sauver des vies L'Université de Floride centrale les aidera à y parvenir.

lists.title: University of the Pacific
lists.description: L'Université du Pacifique est située sur un magnifique campus à une heure et demie de San Francisco. En plus des sciences humaines, l'Université compte des facultés d'éducation, d'ingénierie et d'économie et des écoles de spécialisation en médecine dentaire, droit, pharmacie et sciences de la santé. C'est la plus ancienne université basée en Californie et dans le Pacifique. Elle a également été la première de l'État à accueillir des femmes.

lists.title: University of South Carolina
lists.description: L'université de Caroline du Sud est l'endroit où les étudiants se préparent à trouver des solutions créatives et brillantes aux problèmes de l'avenir et à guider les générations futures vers un style de vie plus sain, plus intelligent et plus vivant.

lists.title: University of Illinois at Chicago
lists.description: L’Université de l’Illinois à Chicago (UIC) offre aux étudiants du monde entier des possibilités d’éducation en mettant l’accent sur la diversité et en offrant aux étudiants un environnement d’apprentissage multiethnique et culturellement riche.

lists.title: The University of Utah
lists.description: L'université de l'Utah est l'une des meilleurs du pays à créer des startups basées sur la recherche d'étudiants et d'enseignants. Ceci est le résultat de la pensée novatrice qui imprègne tout le campus et les salles de classe.

lists.title: University of Dayton
lists.description: L'université de Dayton est l'une des principales universités catholiques pour la recherche et la plus grande université privée de l'Ohio. Fondée en 1850 par la Société de Marie (Marianistes), l’Université se caractérise par la philosophie éducative marianiste d’apprentissage en communauté, d’accueil, de service aux autres, de curiosité intellectuelle et de rigueur académique pour former les futurs dirigeants en capable de combiner l'apprentissage avec le leadership et le service communautaire.

lists.title: UMass Amherst
lists.description: UMass Amherst est l'une des principales universités de recherche publiques en Amérique. Niché dans l'idyllique Amherst, dans le Massachusetts, le campus s'est toujours classé parmi les meilleures universités de recherche publiques du pays et offre un environnement culturel riche à proximité des grands centres urbains.

lists.title: University of Cincinnati
lists.description: L'université de Cincinnati, qui héberge dix sociétés Fortune 500, est un centre pour les futurs succès, les dirigeants et tous ceux qui ont soif de connaissances. N ° 135 parmi les universités nationales selon U.S News & World, c'est une association étudiante fière et soudée composée d'un quart de million d'anciens étudiants du monde entier.

campus.title: Conventions Universitaire
campus.description: MLI a conclu des accords spéciaux ou des programmes de reconnaissance mutuelle avec de nombreuses universités de la région de Los Angeles. Ces accords MRP permettent aux étudiants de transférer sans score TOEFL® et certains permettent également une inscription simultanée, ce qui signifie que les étudiants MLI peuvent prendre des leçons à temps partiel tout en restant inscrits à MLI. Les étudiants doivent avoir terminé avec succès le programme MLI High-Intermediate pour être éligibles.

lists.title: Santa Monica College
lists.description: Santa Monica College a transféré plus d'étudiants dans les universités de Californie que toutes autres universités du pays pendant 27 années consécutives. SMC est également au top des transferts vers UCLA, USC et l'Université Loyola Marymount et l'ouest du Mississippi a transféré le plus grand nombre d'étudiants vers la prestigieuse Université Columbia.

lists.title: Glendale Community College
lists.description: Le Glendale Community College est une institution dynamique comptant plus de 25 000 étudiants. Les étudiants qui souhaitent obtenir des crédits scolaires sont inscrits au Campus Verdugo pour suivre une formation continue au Campus Garfield. Des cours de service communautaire sont toutefois organisés dans toute la communauté et au centre de développement professionnel (PDC) de Montrose. L'Université est constitué d'un groupe d'étudiants d'ethnies diverses, où aucun groupe ne représente la majorité.

lists.title: Pasadena City College
lists.description: Le Pasadena City College offre à la vallée de San Gabriel un environnement d’apprentissage innovant, dynamique et de grande qualité qui favorise la réussite des étudiants. Chaque semestre, nous proposons des programmes académiques comprenant des diplômes, des programmes de transfert et des certificats à plus de 30 250 étudiants. Nous comptons parmi les étudiants de première année et les étudiants qui retournent à l'école. Nous avons des étudiants locaux, internationaux et en ligne. Nous sommes déterminés à rassembler différentes cultures et++ communautés, telles que les personnes LGBT, les anciens combattants et beaucoup d'autres.

lists.title: Cypress College
lists.description: Cypress College met l’accent sur l’éducation pour chaque étudiant. L'excellence de l'enseignement et les ateliers d'apprentissage personnalisés augmentent la possibilité pour les étudiants d'atteindre leur potentiel maximum. En outre, une équipe de tuteurs et de consultants à temps plein fournit un soutien pédagogique et de nombreuses informations d’orientation pour aider les étudiants à choisir les programmes et les cours. Pour l'étudiant qui a l'intention de compléter un bachelor, l'université propose une transition progressive du lycée à l'université.

lists.title: West Los Angeles College
lists.description: West Los Angeles College est un California Community College accrédité qui propose des filières de transfert universitaire, une formation professionnelle et des cours de développement personnel ou professionnel. Le collège dispose de 70 hectares de parcs surplombant Culver City, Marina Del Rey et le Grand Ouest de Los Angeles. Par temps clair, depuis les points culminants du campus, vous pouvez voir l’océan Pacifique. Avec une population étudiante active de près de 12 000 étudiants réguliers, 110 professeurs à temps plein, plus de 300 professeurs à temps partiel et 112 employés créent un environnement éducatif unique en Californie du Sud.

lists.title: El Camino College
lists.description:
Saviez-vous qu'El Camino College offre des programmes exceptionnels?
  • Une institution importante dans le sud de la Californie pour le transfert d'étudiants à l'université
  • Emplacement pratique et grand parking
  • Programmes d'apprentissage exceptionnels pour la communauté
  • Plus de 80 programmes de développement professionnel très appréciés

lists.title: Pierce College
lists.description: Pierce College est une institution publique prospère du sud de la Californie qui offre des possibilités de formation professionnelle et continue. Pierce combine l'excellence académique du personnel enseignant avec un personnel amical et serviable. Il a une solide réputation d'être une institution ouverte aux étudiants en leur offrant une éducation de haute qualité et stimulante qui les préparera au travail universitaire ou professionnel. Les étudiants de Pierce bénéficient de classes plus petites à un coût réduit.

lists.title: LATCC - Traning. Transfer. Tradition. Trade Tech.
lists.description: Mission Los Angeles Trade Technical College aide diverses communautés par le biais de parcours académiques et professionnels qui permettent aux étudiants d’obtenir des certificats et des diplômes de premier cycle. Notre vision: Los Angeles Trade Technical College sera un excellent collège communautaire reconnu aux niveaux régional et national pour transformer la vie des étudiants et de leurs communautés.

lists.title: Los Angeles Harbor College
lists.description: Los Angeles Harbor College favorise la réussite de ses étudiants par le biais de diplômes, de certificats, du développement économique et social et de l'enseignement des compétences de base. Nos programmes éducatifs et nos services d'assistance répondent aux besoins de différentes communautés, comme en témoignent les résultats de l'apprentissage sur le campus.

lists.title: New York Film Academy
lists.description: Au cours des 25 dernières années, la New York Film Academy (NYFA) a acquis la réputation d'être l'une des meilleures écoles d'arts visuels et de divertissement au monde. Nos programmes innovants sont conçus pour une nouvelle génération d'écrivains et pour les artistes qui partagent une passion pour les arts visuels grâce à l'utilisation pratique d'un large éventail de supports. Avec une approche incomparable de l'apprentissage interactif et pratique, les étudiants sont complètement immergés dans leur programme dès le premier jour. Les cours sont dispensés par des professionnels primés dans un environnement réel doté d'installations et d'équipements à la pointe de la technologie.

lists.title: Los Angeles City College
lists.description:
LACC offre un environnement d'apprentissage dynamique et innovant offrant plus de 100 programmes professionnels, y compris des diplômes, des programmes de transfert et des certificats à plus de 18 000 étudiants. En 2019, LACC célébrera son 90e anniversaire.
Dans le cadre de la promesse du Collège de LA, nous offrons une année d'inscription gratuite à tous les étudiants à temps plein diplômés des lycées et écoles à charte de LAUSD. Nous offrons également aux majors de la musique des cours gratuits, des cours privés et une aide financière grâce à un don de la Fondation Herb Alpert. De plus, nos étudiants bénéficient d'une grande variété d'options d'aide financière.

contactUs.title: Besoin de plus d'informations? Contactez-nous
contactUs.description: Contactez-nous par téléphone ou via nos réseaux sociaux

lists.title: Adelphi University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Adelphi University يعزز في طلابه شغفا بالمعرفه والفهم والتساؤل حول القيم الثقافية ورؤية لانفسهم كمتعلمين ومستقلين طوال حياتهم ومساهمين في المعرفة والخدمة في عالم دائم التغير

lists.title: American University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: International Accelerator يقدم البرنامج مجموعة واسعه ومرنة من التخصصات لمختلف المستويات. يمكن للطلاب دراسة تخصصين, أو دراسة تخصص ثاني بالاضافة للتخصص الرئيسي الذي درسة,يمكن للطالب الالتحاق بجامعتنا ك جامعة اضافية بالاضافة لجامعته الرئيسية . International Accelerator يشجع الطلاب توسيع دائرته الثقافية بتعدد التخصصات.

lists.title: Auburn University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: تسعى جامعة أبرون إلى تهيئة الطلاب للاقتضاد العالمي في الوقت الحالي, مكتب الطلاب الدوليين يقدم المعلومات اللازمة للطلاب عن الهجرة وخيارات الدراسة في الخارج والعديد من المعلومات, كما يقدم معلومات عن المبادرات التي ترعاها الوحدات الأكاديمي, و القبول الجامعي لطلاب البكالوريوس و الدراسات العليا.

lists.title: Floria International University
lists.description: ترحب منظمة Florida International بالطلاب في مجتمع متنوع وودي, حيث تساعد الاتصالات الصناعية وفرص التدريب في اطلاق حياتهم المهنية في سوق عالمية. في Flu سوف يتلقون تعليم متميز في مدينة ريادة الاعمال.

lists.title: Louisiana State University
lists.description: الحصول على درجة Louisiana State University هو استثمار في مستقبل الطالب. تقدم Louisiana State University تعليما استثنائيا وفرصا للحصول على خبره جامعيه ممتازة و برسوم دراسية جيدة.

lists.title: The University of Kansas
lists.description: مجموعة من المنح الدراسية المتقدمة والاختراع والاكتشاف , يوفر جامعة KU التعليم الذي يسهم في بناء قادة العالم , والرواد في العديد من المجالات  المختلفة, وكما انه يسهم في اثراء خبرات الطلاب الجامعية التي من سوفل تعود بأثر ايجابي وتغير حياتهم.

lists.title: University of Central Florida
lists.description: الطلاب لديهم احلام كبيره.ربما يريدون السفر حول العالم او ادارة اعمالهم الخاصه او الاحتفاظ براءات الاختراع التي تساعد في انقاذ الارواح. سوف تساعدهم جامعة Central Florida في تحقيق أحلامهم

lists.title: University of the Pacific
lists.description: تقع الجامعه الدولية Pacific في حرم جامعي جميل على بعد 1.5 ساعه من سان فرانسيسكو. تقدم الجامعة مختلف التخصص منها التالي: الفنون الليبرالية,الهندسة والاعمال ,وكذلك تقدم برامج للدراسات العليا في طب الاسنان ,والقانون , والصيدلة, والعلوم الصحية. تعتبر الجامعه الدولية Pacific اقدم جامعة مستاجره في ولاية كاليفورنيا, كما أنها أول جامعة قدمت قبول للطالبات.

lists.title: University of South Carolina
lists.description: جامعة South Carolina هي المكان الذي يستعيد فيه الطلاب ليكونوا حل المشكلات في المستقبل , واللذين سيقودون الاجيال القادمة الى اسلوب حياة اكثر صحة وذكاء واكثر حيوية.

lists.title: University of Illinois at Chicago
lists.description: توسع جامعة University of llinois في شيكاغو الفرص التعليمية للطلاب من جميع انحاء العالم من خلال التركيز على التنوع وتزويد الطلاب ببيئة تعلم ثرية ثقافيا.

lists.title: The University of Utah
lists.description: تعتبر جامعة ولاية Utah واحده من افضل الجامعات في البلاد في انشاء الشركات الناشئة على اساس ابحاث الطلاب والهيئات التدريسية. وهذا يدل على التفكير المبتكر والجهود المبذولة من كادر الجامعة لمساعدة الطلاب على تحقيق طموحاتهم.

lists.title: University of Dayton
lists.description: تتميز الجامعة بالفلسفة التعليمية لتعلم المجتمع, و الترحيب بالجميع, و خدمة الآخرين, كما أنها تحفز التفكير الناقد لتعزيز القادة الذين يربطون التعليم مع الخدمة و القيادة.

lists.title: UMass Amherst
lists.description: UMass Amherst هي واحده من اكبر جامعات الابحاث العامة في امريكا. يتم تصنيف الحرم الجامعي في Amherst, Massachusetts , وهو من افضل الجامعات العامة للابحاث في البلاد , ويوفر بيئة ثقافية غنية في بيئة. ريفية قريبه من المراكز الحضرية الرئيسية

lists.title: University of Cincinnati
lists.description: مع Cincinnati موطن لخمسة عشر الف شركة, فان جامعة Cincinnati هي مركز للمستقبل , وقادة, والذين لديهم عطش للمعرفة. في المرتبة رقم 135 في الجامعات الوطنية وفقا لتقرير الولايات المتحدة والاخبار العالمية, فانه يفتخر بتخريج عدد كبير من الطلاب من جميع انحاء العالم.

campus.title: College Agreements
campus.description: لدى MLI اتفاقيات خاصة, او كليات منطقة Mutual Angeles. تتيح برامج التعرف على (MRP) هذه , مع العديد من خانات Los للطلاب نقل نقاط TOEFL والبعض الاخر يسمح بالتسجيل المتزامن, مما يعني ان طلاب MLI يستطيعون الحصول على درجات الائتمان بدوام جزئي بينما لا يزالون مسجلين في MLI. يجب على الطلاب ان يستكملوا برنامج MLI عالي المستوى ليكونوا مؤهلين.

lists.title: Santa Monica College
lists.description: على مدار 27 عام على التوالي ساهمت كلية سانتامونيكا في تحويل الطلاب إلى العديد من الجامعات في كاليفورنيا ومنها جامعة UCLA, USC ,وكذلك جامعة Loyola Marymount. وكذلك أيضا في ولاية Mississippi الى جامعة Ivy league Columbia

lists.title: Glendale Community College
lists.description: تعد كلية Glendale مؤسسة ديناميكية تضم اكثر من 25000 طالبا. يتم تسجيل ساعاتهم الدراسية في الحرم الجامعي erdugo, كما أنهم يتلقون التعليم المستمر في حرم غارفيلد, وفصول الخدمات المجتمعية التي تخدم المجتمع, ومركز التطوير المهني (PDC) الموجود في Montrose. تخدم الكلية هيئة طلابية متنوعة بشكل كبير, ولا توجد مجموعة واحده تشكل الاغلبية

lists.title: Pasadena City College
lists.description: توفر كلية Pasadena بيئة تعليمية عالية الجودة ومبتكره وديناميكية تلهم نجاح الطلاب. في كل فصل دراسي تقدم برامج اكاديمية تشمل الدرجات العلمية, ومعادلة الساعات للطلاب الذين يرغبون التحويل, والشهادات الى اكثر من 30,250 طالبا. نحن نرحب بالجميع بم في ذلك الطلاب جدد والطلاب عائدين. و الطلاب المحليين, من يرغبون التعليم عن بعد عن طريق الانترنت. كليتنا ترحب  العديد من الثقافات -LGBT, متعددةالثقافات,وقدامى المحاربين, و جميع المتهمين.

lists.title: Cypress College
lists.description: تؤكد كلية Cypress على تعليم للطالب الفردي, يمنح امتياز التعليم ومختبرات التعليم الفردية امكانية تحقيق الطلاب لاعلى امكانتهم, بالاضافه الى ذلك, يقدم فريق من المدرسين والمستشارين المتفرغين الدعم التعليمي ومعلومات توجيهية مكثفة لمساعدة الطلاب في اختيارهم للبرامج والدروس. بالنسبه للطلاب الذين يخططون لاكمال درجة البكالوريوس, توفر الكلية انتقالا سلسا من المدرسة الى الكليات والجامعات.

lists.title: West Los Angeles College
lists.description: كلية West Los Angeles هي كلية معتمده من كاليفورنيا تساهم في مساعدة الطلاب للتحويل إلى الجامعة , والتعليم المهني كما تسعى للتنمية الشخصية او المهنية. مع وجود عدد طلاب نشط من 12,000 طالب في المرحلة التحضيرية والارشاد, يعمل لدينا 110 من اعضاء هيئة التدريس المتفرغين, واكثر من 300 موظف في كل ساعة و 112 موظفا متخصصا في انشاء بيئة تعليمية فريدة في جنوب كاليفورنيا.

lists.title: El Camino College
lists.description:
هل تعلم ان كلية El Camino تقدم العديد من الميزاتت الرائعة؟
  • مؤسسة رائدة بجنوب كالليفورنيا
  • في موقع ملائم ومتسع لوقوف السيارات
  • برامج تعليم المجتمع المتميز
  • اكثر من 80 برنامج مهني موصى به.

lists.title: Pierce College
lists.description: كلية Pierce هي مؤسسة مزدهرة لمدة عامين في جنوب كاليفورنيا توفر فرصا لنقل التعليم والتدريب المهني والتعلم مدى الحياة, وتجمع بين التميز الاكاديمي مع هيئة التدريس والموظفين اللطيفين والذين يقدمون مساعدتهم المستمرة للطلاب. يتمتع المعهد بسمعة قوية كونه مؤسسة ملائمة للطلاب, حيث يقدم للطلاب تعليما عالي الجودة ومليء بالتحديات من شأنه إعداد التعليم الجامعي او المهني. يستفيد الطلاب Pierce من صغر أحجام الفصول الدراسة وكذلك إنخفتض الرسوم الدراسية مقارنة بالجامعة ذات الأربع سنوات.

lists.title: LATCC - Traning. Transfer. Tradition. Trade Tech.
lists.description: هدفنا هو: أن الكلية التجارة التقنية في لوس انجلوس تقدم المجتمعات من خلال المسارات الى النجاح الاكاديمي والمهني, ونقل النجاح لتقوية الطلاب من أجل الحصول على الشهادات الفنية المهنية, والدرجات الجامعية , والنقل, والتوظيف. رؤيتنا: ستصبح كلية لوس انجلوس التقنية التجارية كاكبر مجتمع محلي معترف به اقليميا ووطنيا لتحويل حياة الطلاب ومجتمعاتهم.

lists.title: Los Angeles Harbor College
lists.description: تعمل كلية Los Angeles Harbor على تعزيز نجاح الطالب من خلال درجات الزمالة , والشهادات , والتطوير الاقتصادي وتنمية القوى العاملة , وتعليم المهارات الاساسية. تلبي برامجنا التعليمية وخدمات الدعم تحقق احتياجات المجتمعات المتنوعة وفقا لحصائل التعليم المؤسسي في الحرم الجامعي.

lists.title: New York Film Academy
lists.description: على مدى السنوات 25 الماضية , قامت New York Film Academy ببناء سمعة كالمدرسة الرائده في الفنون المرئية وفنون الاداء في العالم. تم تصميم برامجنا المبتكرة لجيل جديد من رواة القصص للفنانين الذين يشتركون في شغف الفنون البصرية والمسرحية , عبر مجموعة واسعة من وسائل الاعلام ويرغبون في التعليم من خلال العمل. من خلال منهج منقطع النظير للتعليم العملي , يجد الطلاب انفسهم شغفهم في مجرى دراستهم منذ اليوم الاول. حيق يتم تدريس الفصول الدراسية من قبل المتخصصين في الصناعة الحائزين على جوائز , في بيئة اقتصادية حقيقية مزوده باحداث معدات المرافق.

lists.title: Los Angeles City College
lists.description:
يوفر LACC بيئة تعليمية ديناميكية ومبتكرة تقدم أكثر من 100 برنامج مهني ومهني بما في ذلك الدرجات وبرامج التحويل والشهادات لأكثر من 18000 طالب. في عام 2019 ، ستحتفل LACC بالذكرى التسعين لتأسيسها.
بموجب وعد LA College ، نقدم عامًا واحدًا من التسجيل المجاني لجميع الطلاب بدوام كامل المتخرجين من المدارس الثانوية والمدارس المستقلة في LAUSD. نحن نقدم أيضًا دروسًا في مجال الموسيقى ، وحضورًا مجانيًا ، ودروسًا خاصة ومساعدة مالية بفضل هدية من The Herb Alpert Foundation. بالإضافة إلى ذلك ، يستفيد طلابنا من مجموعة متنوعة من خيارات المساعدة المالية.

contactUs.title: لمعلومات اكثر تواصل معنا.
contactUs.description: للتواصل عن طريق الهاتف او البريد الاكتروني او عبر قنوات التواصل الاجتماعي الخاصة بنا.

_data.pageDescription: Students who finish Mentor Language Institute's advanced-level classes can apply to these Bachelor's degree and Master's degree programs without TOEFL or IELTS upon completion of the university's approved language exam and meeting their academic qualifications.
_data.title: MLI University and College Pathways Partners

university.title: University Agreements
university.description: Students who finish Mentor Language Institute's advanced-level classes can apply to these Bachelor's degree and Master's degree programs without TOEFL or IELTS upon completion of the university's approved language exam and meeting their academic qualifications.'

lists.title: Adelphi University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Adelphi fosters in its students a passion for knowledge, an understanding and questioning of cultural values and a view of themselves as independent, lifelong learners and contributors to knowledge and service in an ever-changing world.

lists.title: American University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: AU offers a broad and flexible choice of majors and minors. Students may double major, construct their own interdisciplinary major, or have their major in one school and a minor in another. AU encourages students to transcend the boundaries of academic disciplines.

lists.title: Auburn University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Auburn University is committed to preparing our students for today's global economy. The Office of International Programs site provides information on the international presence of Auburn University such as the Office of International Education, which provides International Student/Scholar immigration advising, study abroad options and more, information on initiatives sponsored by the academic units, and international admissions for undergraduate and graduate students.

lists.title: Floria International University
lists.description: Florida International welcomes students to a diverse, friendly community where industry connections and internship opportunities will help launch their career in a global marketplace. At FIU they’ll receive an outstanding education in an entrepreneurial city.

lists.title: Louisiana State University
lists.description: Earning an LSU degree is an investment in a student’s future. LSU offers an exceptional education and opportunities to have a fulfilling but affordable college experience.

lists.title: The University of Kansas
lists.description: A world of advanced scholarship, invention and discovery, KU provides an education that produces global leaders, business giants and visionaries in many fields, and an undergraduate student experience that will change their life.

lists.title: University of Central Florida
lists.description: Students have big dreams. Maybe they want to travel the world, run their own business or hold patents that help save lives. The University of Central Florida will help them get there.

lists.title: University of the Pacific
lists.description: University of the Pacific is located on a beautiful campus 1.5 hours from San Francisco. In addition to liberal arts, the University has schools of education, engineering and business, and graduate schools in dentistry, law, pharmacy and health sciences. The oldest chartered university in California, Pacific was first in the state to admit women.

lists.title: University of South Carolina
lists.description: The University of South Carolina is where students prepare to be tomorrow’s creative problem solvers who will lead future generations to a healthier, smarter and more vibrant way of life.

lists.title: University of Illinois at Chicago
lists.description: University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC) broadens educational opportunities for students from across the globe through an emphasis on diversity and providing students with an ethnically and culturally rich learning environment.

lists.title: The University of Utah
lists.description: The University of Utah is one of the best in the nation at creating startup companies based on student and faculty research. This is indicative of the innovative and industrious thinking found across campus and in classrooms.

lists.title: University of Dayton
lists.description: The University of Dayton is a top-tier national Catholic research university and the largest private university in Ohio. Founded in 1850 by the Society of Mary (Marianists), the University is characterized by the Marianist educational philosophy of learning in community, welcoming all, serving others, intellectual curiosity and academic rigor to foster servant-leaders who connect learning with leadership and service.

lists.title: UMass Amherst
lists.description: UMass Amherst is one of the major public research universities in America. Nestled in idyllic Amherst, Massachusetts, the campus is consistently ranked among the top public research universities in the nation, and offers a rich cultural environment in a rural setting close to major urban centers.

lists.title: University of Cincinnati
lists.description: With Cincinnati home to ten fortune 500 companies, the University of Cincinnati is a center for future achievers, leaders, and those with a thirst for knowledge. Ranked #135 in National Universities according to U.S. News & World Report, it boasts school spirit with a quarter-million bearcat alumni worldwide.

campus.title: College Agreements
campus.description: MLI has special agreements, or Mutual Recognition Programs (MRP), with many Los Angeles area colleges. These MRP agreements allow students to transfer without a TOEFL® score, and some also allow concurrent enrollment, which means MLI students can take part-time credit classes while still enrolled at MLI. Students must successfully complete MLI's high-intermediate program to be eligible.

lists.title: Santa Monica College
lists.description: Santa Monica College has transferred more students to the University of California campuses than any other college in the country—for 27  years straight. SMC also tops in transfers to UCLA, USC and Loyola Marymount University, and is the top feeder west of the Mississippi to the Ivy League Columbia University.

lists.title: Glendale Community College
lists.description: Glendale Community College is a dynamic institution with more than 25,000 students. They are enrolled in college-credit at the Verdugo Campus, continuing education at the Garfield Campus, community services classes held throughout the community, and the Professional Development Center (PDC) located in Montrose. The college serves an ethnically diverse student body with no single group forming a majority.

lists.title: Pasadena City College
lists.description: Pasadena City College provides the San Gabriel Valley with a high quality, innovative and dynamic learning environment that inspires student success. Each semester we offer academic programs that encompass degrees, transfer programs, and certificates, to 30,250+ students. We are new students and returning students. We are local, international, and online. We span many cultures — LGBT, multicultural, veterans, and everyone else in between.

lists.title: Cypress College
lists.description: Cypress College emphasizes education for the individual student. Excellence of instruction and individualized learning laboratories enhance the possibility for students to achieve their highest potential. In addition, a staff of tutors and full-time counselors provides instructional support and extensive guidance information to aid students in their choice of programs and classes. For the student who plans to complete a bachelors degree, the college provides a smooth transition from high school to colleges and universities.

lists.title: West Los Angeles College
lists.description: West Los Angeles College is an accredited California Community College offering paths to university transfer, career education and courses for personal or professional growth. It occupies 70 park-like acres overlooking Culver City, Marina Del Rey and Greater West Los Angeles. On a clear day, from the highest points on campus, you can see the Pacific Ocean. With an active student population of nearly 12,000 regular and extension students, our 110 full-time faculty, more than 300 hourly faculty and 112 classified staff create an educational environment unique in Southern California.

lists.title: El Camino College
lists.description:
Did you know El Camino College offers many outstanding features?
  • A leading Southern California transfer institution
  • Conveniently located and ample parking
  • Outstanding community education programs
  • Over 80 highly acclaimed career programs

lists.title: Pierce College
lists.description: Pierce College is a flourishing two-year public institution in Southern California providing opportunities for transfer education, occupational training, and life-long learning. Pierce combines academic excellence with a friendly and helpful faculty and staff. It has a solid reputation for being a student-friendly institution, offering students high-quality and challenging education that will prepare them for university or vocational work. Pierce students benefit from smaller class sizes and lower tuition than a four-year university.

lists.title: LATCC - Traning. Transfer. Tradition. Trade Tech.
lists.description: Mission Statement: Los Angeles Trade Technical College advances communities through pathways to academic, career, and transfer success that empower students to achieve career technical certificates, associate degrees, transfer, and employment. Our Vision: Los Angeles Trade Technical College will be a premier community college recognized regionally and nationally for transforming students’ lives and their communities.

lists.title: Los Angeles Harbor College
lists.description: Los Angeles Harbor College promotes access and student success through associate and transfer degrees, certificates, economic and workforce development, and basic skills instruction. Our educational  programs and support  services meet the needs of diverse communities as measured by campus institutional learning outcomes.

lists.title: New York Film Academy
lists.description: Over the past 25 years, the New York Film Academy (NYFA) has built a reputation as one of the premier visual and performing arts schools in the world. Our innovative programs are designed for a new generation of storytellers – for artists who share a passion for visual and performing arts, across a wide array of media and want to learn by doing. With an unrivaled approach to hands-on, interactive learning, students find themselves completely immersed in their course of study from day one. Classes are taught by award-winning industry professionals, in a real-world environment with state-of-the-art facilities and equipment.

lists.title: Los Angeles City College
lists.description:
LACC provides a dynamic and innovative learning environment offering more than 100 vocational and professional programs including degrees, transfer programs, and certificates to more than 18,000 students. In 2019, LACC will celebrate its 90th anniversary.
Under the LA College Promise, we offer one year of free enrollment to all full-time students graduating from LAUSD high schools and charter schools. We also offer music majors tuition free attendance, private lessons and financial aid thanks to a gift from The Herb Alpert Foundation. Additionally, our students benefit from a wide variety of financial aid options.

contactUs.title: Need More Information? Contact us
contactUs.description: Contact us by phone, email or via our social media channels.

university.title: 大学合作协议
university.description: 如果学生能够完成MLI的高级课程，通过学校考试并达到相应的要求后，则无需再考取托福或雅思成绩，即可申请这些大学的学士学位和硕士学位课程。

lists.title: Adelphi University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: 阿德菲大学（Adelphi）旨在培养学生对文化价值的学习和理解。要求学生将自己置身于一个独立的终身学习者和传播者，并在不断变化的世界中为传播知识做出贡献。

lists.title: American University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: 美国大学华盛顿(American University Washington) 提供了广泛且灵活的主修专业和辅修专业的选择。学生可以选择修读双专业，也可以跨专业学习，还可以在学校修主专业，在另外一所学校辅修其他课程。 AU也鼓励学生跨越学科的界限，学习更广泛的知识。

lists.title: Auburn University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: 奥本大学（Auburn University）旨在培养与时俱进的学生。 国际项目办公室提供给国际学生和学者移民咨询，出国留学咨询等各种服务。同时也提供相关学术单位赞助的信息和国际本科生及研究生项目咨询。

lists.title: Floria International University
lists.description: 佛罗里达国际学院（Florida International ）欢迎每一位学生加入和谐融洽的多元化校园。在这里，学生有机会与同行人事交流也能申请实习机会，这将有助于他们更快适应全球经济发展。

lists.title: Louisiana State University
lists.description: 获得LSU学位是对学生未来的投资。 LSU提供卓越的教育和机会，让您拥有充实而实惠的大学体验。

lists.title: The University of Kansas
lists.description: 作为一个拥有先进学术、发明和发现的大学，KU提供的教育培养出许多领域的全球领袖、企业家和梦想家，同时也将改变本科生的生活。

lists.title: University of Central Florida
lists.description: 学生们有远大的梦想。也许他们想周游世界，想拥有自己的事业，或是拥有某项专利帮助他人。University of Central Florida 将帮助他们实现这一目标。

lists.title: University of the Pacific
lists.description: 太平洋大学（Univerity of the Pacific ）的美丽校园位于距旧金山1.5小时车程。该大学除了文科以外，还设有教育学、工程学和商学院，以及牙科，法学，药学和健康科学的研究生院。Univerity of the Pacific是加州历史最悠久的特许大学，也是加州第一个招收女性学生的大学。

lists.title: University of South Carolina
lists.description: 南卡罗来纳大学（The University of South Carolina）正在培养富有创造力的学生，他们将带领我们过上更健康、更有活力的生活。

lists.title: University of Illinois at Chicago
lists.description: 伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校(UIC)注重学习多样性为学生提供丰富的民族文化学习环境，也为来自世界各地的学生拓宽了学习机会。

lists.title: The University of Utah
lists.description: 犹他大学(University of Utah)是美国最擅长以学生和教师研究为基础创建初创公司的大学之一。这一特点说明了大学校园充满了创造性思维。

lists.title: University of Dayton
lists.description: 代顿大学（The University of Dayton）是美国顶尖的天主教研究大学，也是俄亥俄州最大的私立大学。学校成立于1850年，由玛丽学会(Mary Society of Marianists)创立，该大学以社区学习理念为特色，面向所有人培养学习与领导、服务相结合的服务型领导人才。

lists.title: UMass Amherst
lists.description: 麻省大学阿默斯特分校（UMass Amherst）是美国主要的公立研究型大学之一,名列全美国顶尖的公立研究型大学之列。它坐落在田园诗般的麻省阿姆赫斯特，在靠近城市中心的地区提供了丰富的文化环境。

lists.title: University of Cincinnati
lists.description: 辛辛那提（Cincinnati）拥有10家财富500强企业，辛辛那提大学（The University of Cincinnati ）是未来成功人士、领导者和求知欲的中心。根据《美国新闻与世界报》的报道，全国各大学排名第135位，学校的校友会在全球范围内有25万的校友。

campus.title: 大学协议
campus.description: MLI与许多洛杉矶地区学院签订了特殊协议或相互认可计划（MRP）。这些MRP协议允许学生在没有TOEFL分数的情况下进行转学，有些大学也允许同时注册，这意味着MLI学生可以既在MLI上课同时兼职学分课程。学生必须完成MLI的高中级课程才有资格转学。

lists.title: Santa Monica College
lists.description: 在过去的27年里，从Santa Monica转学到 UCLA,南加州大学(USC)和洛约拉马利蒙特大学(Loyola Marymount University) 及其他加州大学校区的学生，已超过美国其他任何一所大学所转出的人数。还有部分成绩优异的学生还转学到常青藤盟校哥伦比亚大学(Columbia University)。

lists.title: Glendale Community College
lists.description: 格伦代尔社区学院（Glendale Community College）是一所充满活力的学院，拥有25,000多名学生。他们在Verdugo注册学习获得大学学分，在Garfield校园继续教育，也在整个社区以及位于Montrose的专业发展中心(PDC)举办社区服务课程。格伦代尔社区学院（Glendale Community College）是一个民族多元化的学生群体。

lists.title: Pasadena City College
lists.description: 帕萨迪纳城市学院（Pasadena City College）为圣盖博山谷提供了一个高质量、创新和动态的学习环境，不断激励学生走向成功。每学期我们都会为30250多名学生提供包括学位、转学和证书在内的学术课程。我们拥有新生，老生,有本地学生，国际学生和在线学生。我们跨越了许多文化——LGBT、多元文化、退伍军人，以及其他人。

lists.title: Cypress College
lists.description: 柏树学院强调个人教育。优质的教学和个性化的学习实验室提高了学生发挥最大潜能的可能性。此外，教师和专职辅导员的工作人员提供教学支持和广泛的指导信息，以帮助学生更好的选择项目和课程。对于准备完成学士学位的学生来说，学院提供了从高中到大学的平稳过渡。

lists.title: West Los Angeles College
lists.description: 西洛杉矶学院是经认证的加州社区学院，提供大学转学、职业教育和个人或职业成长课程。它占地70英亩，可以俯瞰卡尔弗市、玛丽娜德雷和大西部洛杉矶。晴朗天气，从校园的最高点，你可以看到太平洋。我们拥有活跃的学生群体，近12000名学生，110名全职教师，300多名小时制教师和112名分类员工，创造了南加州独一无二的教育环境。

lists.title: El Camino College
lists.description:
你知道埃尔卡米诺学院（ El Camino College）有许多突出的特色吗?
  • 南加州顶尖的转学机构
  • 地理位置优越，停车位充足
  • 优秀的社区教育项目
  • 80多个优质的职业规划

lists.title: Pierce College
lists.description: 皮尔斯学院（Pierce College）是南加州一所蓬勃发展的两年制公立学校，提供转学教育、职业培训和终身学习的机会。皮尔斯（Pierce College）将学术成就与友好、乐于助人的教职员工结合在一起。作为一所对学生友好的学校，它有着良好的声誉，为学生提供高质量、富有挑战性的教育，为他们进入大学或职业生涯做准备。皮尔斯大学（Pierce College）的学生受益于小班授课同时也比四年制大学更低的学费。

lists.title: LATCC - Traning. Transfer. Tradition. Trade Tech.
lists.description: 办学理念:洛杉矶贸易技术学院（ Los Angeles Trade Technical College ）通过学术和就业促进社区发展，让学生获得职业技术证书，学位和工作。学院目标: 洛杉矶贸易技术学院将成为一所一流的社区学院，改善学生的生活，获得地区和全国的认可。洛杉矶贸易技术学院提供转入四年制学院专业课程以及很多职业培训项目。

lists.title: Los Angeles Harbor College
lists.description: 洛杉矶海港学院（Los Angeles Harbor College），LAHC为学生提供许多学生服务，例如提供多种专业选择为学生转学准备，新生入学指导、个人顾问、学术建议、就业咨询、技术指导，学生活动和俱乐部等。

lists.title: New York Film Academy
lists.description: 在过去的25年里，纽约电影学院（the New York Film Academy ）作为世界上首屈一指的视觉和表演艺术学校之一名声享誉全球。学院秉持实践出真知，边做边学，坚信每一个对影视有激情和梦想的人都能接受高质量电影教育。学院以创新的课程、优秀的获奖教师、前沿专业的设备吸引了全球大量优秀学子前来就读。获奖电影制作人的课堂讲授与实例操作紧密结合。

lists.title: Los Angeles City College
lists.description:
LACC提供了活耀，创新的学习环境，为超过18,000名学生提供了100多个职业和专业课程，包括学位，转学课程和证书。 LACC将在2019年庆祝其成立90周年。
根据《洛杉矶学院承诺》，我们为所有从LAUSD高中和特许学校毕业的全日制学生提供一年的免费入学。得益于The Herb Alpert Foundation的礼物，我们还为音乐专业的学生提供免费的入学，私人课程和经济援助。此外，我们的学生可以从各种各样的经济援助中受益。

contactUs.title: 如果想要了解更多信息，请随时联系我们
contactUs.description: 可以通过电话，邮件或是我们其他的社交渠道

_data.pageTitle: MLI Partnership con universita' e college | Mentor Language Institute
_data.pageDescription: Gli studenti che terminano le lezioni di livello avanzato presso Mentor Language Institute possono iscriversi a questi corsi di laurea e master senza TOEFL o IELTS al termine dell'esame di lingua approvato dall'università e previa verifica delle qualifiche accademiche propedeutiche all'iscrizione.
_data.title: MLI Partnership con universita' e college

university.title: Accordi con le universita'
university.description: Gli studenti che terminano le lezioni di livello avanzato presso Mentor Language Institute possono iscriversi a questi corsi di laurea e master senza TOEFL o IELTS al termine dell'esame di lingua approvato dall'università e previa verifica delle qualifiche accademiche propedeutiche all'iscrizione.

lists.title: Adelphi University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Adelphi promuove nei suoi studenti la passione per la conoscenza, la comprensione e il dibattito culturale nonche' una visione di se stessi come pensatori indipendenti alla costante ricerca della conoscenza al servizio in un mondo in continua evoluzione.

lists.title: American University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: AU offre una scelta ampia e flessibile di corsi di laurea. Gli studenti possono estendere il loro piano di studi e costruire il proprio diploma interdisciplinare scegliendo diverse concentrazioni. AU incoraggia gli studenti a superare i confini delle discipline accademiche.

lists.title: Auburn University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Ad Auburn University ci impegnamo a preparare i nostri studenti per l'economia globale di oggi. Il nostro sito internet dell'Office of International Programs fornisce informazioni sulla presenza internazionale di Auburn University, mentre l'Office of International Education fornisce consulenza internazionale in materia di immigrazione ai fini di studio, opzioni di studio all'estero e altro, informazioni su iniziative sponsorizzate dai vari dipartimenti accademici e ammissioni internazionali per studenti universitari e laureati.

lists.title: Floria International University
lists.description: Florida International accoglie gli studenti in una comunità diversificata e amichevole, in cui le connessioni e le opportunità di tirocinio li aiuteranno a lanciare la loro carriera in un mercato globale. Alla FIU riceveranno un'istruzione eccezionale in una città imprenditoriale.

lists.title: Louisiana State University
lists.description: Ottenere un diploma LSU è un investimento nel futuro di uno studente. LSU offre un insegnamento eccezionale oltre all'opportunità di avere un'esperienza universitaria soddisfacente ma accessibile.

lists.title: The University of Kansas
lists.description: Tante borse di studio, invenzioni e scoperte avanzate, KU offre una formazione che plasma leader globali, giganti del mondo degli affari e visionari in molti campi oltre a un'esperienza  universitaria che cambierà la loro vita.

lists.title: University of Central Florida
lists.description: Gli studenti hanno grandi sogni. Forse vogliono scoprire il mondo, gestire la propria attività o brevettare invenzioni che possano salvare vite umane. L'Università della Florida centrale li aiuterà a realizzarli.

lists.title: University of the Pacific
lists.description: L'Università del Pacifico si trova in un bellissimo campus a 1,5 ore da San Francisco. Oltre alle materie umanistiche, l'Università ha facolta' di scienze dell'educazione, ingegneria ed economia  e scuole di specializzazione in odontoiatria, giurisprudenza, farmacia e scienze della salute. E' la più antica università con sede in California e nel Pacifico e fu anche la prima nello stato ad ammettere le donne.

lists.title: University of South Carolina
lists.description: L'Università della Carolina del Sud è il luogo in cui gli studenti si preparano a trovare soluzioni creative  e brillanti ai problemi del futuro e a guidare le prossime generazioni verso uno stile di vita più sano, più intelligente e più vivace.

lists.title: University of Illinois at Chicago
lists.description: L'Università dell'Illinois a Chicago (UIC) amplia le opportunità educative per gli studenti di tutto il mondo attraverso un'enfasi sulla diversità e fornendo agli studenti un ambiente di apprendimento multietnico e ricco culturalmente.

lists.title: The University of Utah
lists.description: L'Università dello Utah è una delle migliori della nazione nella creazione di startup basate sulla ricerca di studenti e docenti. Questo è il risultato del modo di pensare innovativo che pervade tutto il campus e le aule.

lists.title: University of Dayton
lists.description: L'Università di Dayton è un'università cattolica di primo piano per quanto riguarda la ricerca ed e' la più grande università privata dell'Ohio. Fondata nel 1850 dalla Società di Maria (marianisti), l'Università è caratterizzata dalla filosofia educativa marianista dell'apprendimento in comunità, dell'accoglienza, del servire gli altri, della curiosità intellettuale e del rigore accademico per formare i futuri leaders che siano in grado di unire l'apprendimento con la leadership e il sevizio alla comunita

lists.title: UMass Amherst
lists.description: UMass Amherst è una delle principali università di ricerca pubbliche in America. Immerso nell'idilliaca Amherst, nel Massachusetts, il campus si è costantemente classificato tra le migliori università di ricerca pubbliche della nazione e offre un ricco ambiente culturale a breve distanza dai maggiori centri urbani.

lists.title: University of Cincinnati
lists.description: Con Cincinnati sede di dieci aziende Fortune 500, l'Università di Cincinnati è un centro per future persone di successo, leader e tutti coloro che hanno sete di conoscenza. N ° 135 tra le Università Nazionali secondo il rapporto U.S. News & World, vanta una associazione studentesca orgogliosa e coesa formata da un quarto di milione di ex studenti sparsi in tutto il mondo.

campus.title: Accordi con i College
campus.description: MLI ha accordi speciali, o programmi di riconoscimento reciproco (MRP), con molti college nell'area di Los Angeles. Questi accordi MRP consentono agli studenti di trasferirsi senza un punteggio TOEFL® e alcuni consentono anche l'iscrizione concorrente, il che significa che gli studenti MLI possono seguire le lezioni part-time mentre sono ancora iscritti a MLI. Gli studenti devono completare con successo il programma High-intermediate di MLI per essere idonei.

lists.title: Santa Monica College
lists.description: Il Santa Monica College ha trasferito più studenti nelle università della California rispetto a qualsiasi altro college nel paese per 27 anni consecutivi. SMC è inoltre in cima ai trasferimenti verso UCLA, USC e Loyola Marymount University e a ovest del Mississippi ha trasferito il maggior numero di studenti verso la prestigiosissima Columbia University.

lists.title: Glendale Community College
lists.description: Glendale Community College è un'istituzione dinamica con oltre 25.000 studenti. Gli studenti che vogliono ottenere crediti scolastici sono iscritti presso il Campus Verdugo, per formazione continua presso il Garfield Campus, i corsi di servizi per la comunità, invece, si tengono in tutta la comunità, e il Professional Development Center (PDC) presso Montrose. Il college e' formato da un corpo studentesco etnicamente diversificato dove nessun gruppo rappresenta la maggioranza.

lists.title: Pasadena City College
lists.description: Il Pasadena City College offre alla valle di San Gabriel un ambiente di apprendimento di alta qualità, innovativo e dinamico che ispira il successo degli studenti. Ogni semestre offriamo programmi accademici che comprendono diplomi, programmi di trasferimento e certificati a oltre 30.250 studenti. Annoveriamo tra gli studenti matricole e studenti che ritornano sui banchi di scuola. Abbiamo studenti locali, internazionali e online. Ci occupiamo di unire diverse culture e comunita' da quella LGBT, ai veterani di guerra e molte altre ancora.

lists.title: Cypress College
lists.description: Cypress College enfatizza l'istruzione per il singolo studente. L'eccellenza dell'insegnamento e dei laboratori di apprendimento personalizzati aumentano la possibilità per gli studenti di raggiungere il loro massimo potenziale. Inoltre, uno staff di tutor e consulenti a tempo pieno fornisce supporto didattico e ampie informazioni di orientamento per aiutare gli studenti nella scelta dei programmi e delle lezioni. Per lo studente che ha intenzione di completare un diploma di laurea, il college offre una transizione graduale dalla scuola superiore all'università.

lists.title: West Los Angeles College
lists.description: West Los Angeles College è un California Community College accreditato che offre percorsi di trasferimento universitario, formazione professionale e corsi per la crescita personale o professionale. Il College e' dotato di 70 ettari di parco che si affacciano su Culver City, Marina Del Rey e Greater West Los Angeles. In una giornata limpida, dai punti più alti del campus, è possibile vedere l'Oceano Pacifico. Con una popolazione studentesca attiva di quasi 12.000 studenti regolari, i nostri 110 docenti a tempo pieno, oltre 300 docenti part time e 112 dipendenti creano un ambiente educativo unico nel sud della California.

lists.title: El Camino College
lists.description:
Lo sapevi che El Camino College offre dei programmi eccezionali?
  • Un istituto importante nel Sud della California per il trasferimento degli studenti all'universita'
  • Posizione comoda e ampio parcheggio
  • Eccezionali programmi di apprendimento per la comunita'
  • Oltre 80 programmi molto acclamati per la crescita professionale

lists.title: Pierce College
lists.description: Il Pierce College una fiorente istituzione pubblica del sud della California che offre opportunità  di formazione professionale e continua. Pierce combina l'eccellenza accademica del corpo docente con del personale cordiale e disponibile. Ha una solida reputazione di essere un'istituzione studentesca aperta, offrendo agli studenti un'istruzione di alta qualità e stimolante che li preparerà all'università o al lavoro professionale. Gli studenti Pierce beneficiano di classi più piccole a un costo ridotto.

lists.title: LATCC - Traning. Transfer. Tradition. Trade Tech.
lists.description: Missione: il Los Angeles Trade Technical College e' di aiuto alle varie comunita' attraverso percorsi accademici e di carriera  professionale che consentono agli studenti di ottenere certificati e diplomi di laurea. La nostra visione: il Los Angeles Trade Technical College sarà un eccellente college comunitario riconosciuto a livello regionale e nazionale per trasformare le vite degli studenti e le loro comunità.

lists.title: Los Angeles Harbor College
lists.description: Il Los Angeles Harbour College promuove il successo dei propri studenti attraverso i diplomi, certificati, lo sviluppo economico e della forza lavoro e l'insegnamento delle competenze di base. I nostri programmi educativi e servizi di supporto soddisfano le esigenze di diverse comunità, come comprovato dai risultati di apprendimento all'interno del campus.

lists.title: New York Film Academy
lists.description: Negli ultimi 25 anni, la New York Film Academy (NYFA) si è costruita una reputazione come una delle migliori scuole di arti visive e dello spettacolo del mondo. I nostri programmi innovativi sono pensati per una nuova generazione di scrittori e per artisti che condividono la passione per le arti visive attraverso l'utilizzo pratico di una vasta gamma di media. Con un approccio impareggiabile all'apprendimento interattivo e pratico, gli studenti si trovano completamente immersi nel loro corso di studi sin dal primo giorno. Le lezioni sono tenute da professionisti del settore pluripremiati, in un ambiente reale con strutture e attrezzature all'avanguardia.

lists.title: Los Angeles City College
lists.description:
LACC fornisce un ambiente di apprendimento dinamico e innovativo che offre più di 100 programmi professionali e professionali tra cui lauree, programmi di trasferimento e certificati a più di 18.000 studenti. Nel 2019, LACC celebrerà il suo 90 ° anniversario.
Con la promessa del LA College, offriamo un anno di iscrizione gratuita a tutti gli studenti a tempo pieno che si diplomano alle scuole superiori e charter LAUSD. Offriamo anche lezioni gratuite per le major di musica, lezioni private e aiuti finanziari grazie a un regalo della Herb Alpert Foundation. Inoltre, i nostri studenti beneficiano di un'ampia varietà di opzioni di aiuto finanziario.

contactUs.title: Hai bisogno di piu' informazioni? Contattaci
contactUs.description: Contattaci via telefono, email o tramite i nostri social media

_data.pageDescription: MLIのアドバンスクラスを修了した学生は、大学の認定語学試験とアカデミックの条件を満たせばTOEFLまたはIELTSのスコアなしで学士号および修士号プログラムに応募することができます。
_data.title: MLI の大学、カレッジ　パスウェイプログラム提携

university.title: 大学協定
university.description: MLIのアドバンスクラスを修了した学生は、大学の認定語学試験とアカデミックの条件を満たせばTOEFLまたはIELTSのスコアなしで学士号および修士号プログラムに応募することができます。

lists.title: Adelphi University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Adelphi では知識に対する情熱、文化的価値の理解と疑問、絶え間なく変化する世界において、独立した生涯学習者、貢献者を育てます。

lists.title: American University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: AUでは、幅広く柔軟に専攻と副専攻の選択肢を提供しています。 学生は専攻を二重にしたり、学際的な専攻科目を編成したり、専攻、副専攻を別の学校でとることも可能。AUは生徒に学問分野の境界を越える奨励をします。

lists.title: Auburn University
lists.subtitle: (Graduate Programs Available)
lists.description: Auburn Universityでは、現代の国際経済に通用する学生を育てます。国際的な学部生および大学院生のための留学生 / 奨学生の入国相談、海外留学のオプションなどを提供する国際教育事務局の案内や、学術機関が後援する取り組みに関する情報などが国際プログラム事務局のサイトでご覧になれます。

lists.title: Floria International University
lists.description: フロリダインターナショナルは生徒が国際社会でのビジネスキャリアを行う為の企業とのつながりや、インターンシップの機会を提供する多様でフレンドリーな環境を提供します。この大学で、生徒は起業家街で素晴らしい教育を受ける事が出来ます。

lists.title: Louisiana State University
lists.description: LSUの学位を取得することは、学生の将来への投資です。  LSUは充実した優れた教育と機会を手頃な価格で提供します

lists.title: The University of Kansas
lists.description: 先進的な奨学金、発明、発見の世界であるKUは、 グローバルリーダー、ビジネス界での兵、 先見の明のある多くの分野を生み出す教育、 そして人生を変える学部生の経験を提供します。

lists.title: University of Central Florida
lists.description: 学生は大きな夢を持っています。 きっと彼らは世界を旅したい、自分のビジネスを営みたい、 命を救うのを手助けする仕事をする為の資格を取りたい。 そんな学生達の夢をセントラルフロリダ大学が手助けします。

lists.title: University of the Pacific
lists.description: 太平洋大学はサンフランシスコより一時間半離れた所に位置されたとてもきれいなキャンパスです。教養課程に加え、この大学は学校教育、エンジニア、ビジネスそして、歯科医、弁護士、薬剤師、健康科学への大学院への学校があります。この大学はカリフォルニアで一番古い学校であり、州で最初に女性を認めた大学でもある。

lists.title: University of South Carolina
lists.description: サウスカロライナ大学は、未来の世代をより健康で賢く、より活気に満ちた生き方に導く明日の創造的問題解決者になるための準備をしている学生です。

lists.title: University of Illinois at Chicago
lists.description: シカゴのイリノイ大学（UIC）は、多様性を重視し、民族的、文化的に豊かな学習環境を学生に提供することで、世界中からの学生の教育機会を広げています。

lists.title: The University of Utah
lists.description: ユタ大学は、学生と教職員の研究に基づいた新興企業の創設において、全国でも最高の大学の1つです。 これは、キャンパス全体や教室で見られる革新的で勤勉な思考を表しています。

lists.title: University of Dayton
lists.description: デイトン大学は一流の国立カトリック研究大学であり、オハイオ州で最大の私立大学です。 1850年にMary of Society（Marianists）によって設立されたこの大学は、コミュニティでの学習、すべての人への奉仕、他者への奉仕、知的好奇心、そして学習をリーダーシップとサービスを結びつける奉仕リーダーを育てるという厳格さというマリアニスト教育理念を特徴としています。

lists.title: UMass Amherst
lists.description: UMass Amherstはアメリカの主要な公的研究大学の一つです。 マサチューセッツ州の牧歌的なアムハーストに囲まれたこのキャンパスは、全国でも有数の公立研究大学にランクされており、主要な都心に近い田園地帯で豊かな文化環境を提供しています。

lists.title: University of Cincinnati
lists.description: シンシナティには、フォーチュン500企業が10社あり、シンシナティ大学は将来の達成者、リーダー、そして知識を渇望している人々の中心地です。 US News＆World Reportによると、国立大学で第135位にランクされており、全世界で4千万のクマの卒業生を擁する学校精神を誇っています。

campus.title: College Agreements
campus.description: MLIは、多くのロサンゼルス地域の大学と特別協定、または相互承認プログラム（MRP）を持っています。 これらのMRP契約では、TOEFL®スコアなしで学生が転校できるようになります。また、同時に入会が許可されることもあります。つまり、MLIの学生は、MLIに在籍しながらパートタイムのクレジットクラスを受講できます。 受講資格を得るには、学生はMLIの中上級プログラムを無事に修了する必要があります。

lists.title: Santa Monica College
lists.description: サンタモニカカレッジは、27年連続で、米国内の他のどの大学よりも多くの学生をカリフォルニア大学のキャンパスに移しています。 SMCはまた、UCLA、USC、およびロヨラメリーマウント大学への移籍でもトップにあり、ミシシッピ州からアイビーリーグコロンビア大学への西側のトップフィーダです。

lists.title: Glendale Community College
lists.description: Glendale Community Collegeは25,000人以上の学生がいるダイナミックなカレッジです。 彼らはVerdugoキャンパスでの大学単位、Garfieldキャンパスでの継続教育、コミュニティ全体で開催されたコミュニティサービスクラス、そしてモントローズにあるプロフェッショナル開発センター（PDC）に在籍しています。 大学は多様な文化的背景を持った学生団体に奉仕し、単一のグループで多数はを成すことはありません。

lists.title: Pasadena City College
lists.description: Pasadena City Collegeは、サンガブリエルバレーで質が高く革新的でダイナミックな学習環境を提供し、学生の成功を促します。 学期ごとに、学位を含む学術プログラム、プログラムの移行、および証明書を30,250人以上の学生に提供しています.地元の学生、留学生、オンライン受講生がいます。そして私たちはLGBT、多様な文化、退役軍人など、様々な背景を持った人々と共存しています。

lists.title: Cypress College
lists.description: Cypress Collegeは個々の学生のための教育に力を入れています。 卓越した指導と個別化された学習室は、学生が最大限の可能性を達成する可能性をサポートします。 さらに、チューターや専任カウンセラーのスタッフが、学生が自分のプログラムやクラスを選択するのを支援するための指導サポートや指導情報を提供します。 学士号を取得することを計画している学生のために、大学へのスムーズな移行を提供します。

lists.title: West Los Angeles College
lists.description: West Los Angeles Collegeは、カリフォルニア大学コミュニティーカレッジの認定を受けており、大学進学、キャリア教育、就職のためコースを提供しています。 カルバーシティ、マリナデルレイ、そしてウェストロサンゼルスを見下ろす公園のような70エーカー程の敷地を持っています。 晴れた日には、キャンパスの最も高い地点から太平洋が見えます。 私たちの110人のフルタイムの教員、300人以上の教員および112人のスタッフが、約12,000人の学生の活発な学生生活やユニークな教育環境を作り出しています。

lists.title: El Camino College
lists.description:
El Camino Collegeが優れた機能を数多く提供していることをご存知ですか？
  • 南カリフォルニアを代表する、大学編入機関
  • 便利な立地と広い駐車場
  • 優れた地域教育プログラム
  • 80以上の高い評価を得ているキャリアプログラム

lists.title: Pierce College
lists.description: Pierce Collegeは、南カリフォルニアにある２年生のカレッジで、大学への編入、職業訓練、生涯学習の機会を提供しています。 Pierceは、優れた学力とフレンドリーで親切な教職員を兼ね備えています。 学生に優しい教育機関として定評があり、学生に高品質でやりがいのある教育を提供し、大学や就職にに備えることができます。 4年制大学に比べても授業料が安く、授業は少人数で構成されています。

lists.title: LATCC - Traning. Transfer. Tradition. Trade Tech.
lists.description: Los Angeles Trade Technical Collegeは、学業、職業、および転職の成功への道を通ってコミュニティを発展させ、学生が職業技術証明書、準学士号、転勤、および雇用を達成することを可能にします。 Los Angeles Trade Technical College は学生の生活やコミュニティを変革することで、全米に認められている最高のコミュニティカレッジです。

lists.title: Los Angeles Harbor College
lists.description: Los Angeles Harbor College は、準学士号および編入学位、修了証書、経済および労働力育成、そして基本的なスキル指導を通じて、学生を成功へと導きます。 私たちの教育プログラムと支援サービスは、キャンパス内の機関学習結果によって測定されるように多様なコミュニティのニーズを満たします。

lists.title: New York Film Academy
lists.description: New York Film Academy(NYFA)は、過去25年間、世界トップクラスのビジュアル・パフォーミング・アーツ・スクールとしての定評を得てきました。 NYFAの革新的なプログラムは、情熱を共有しながら幅広いメディアにまたがって学びたい新しい世代のアーティスト向けに設計されています。 実践的でインタラクティブな学習に比類のないアプローチで、学生は1日目から完全に勉強に没頭しています。授業は最先端の設備を備えた環境で、受賞経歴のある専門家によって行われます。

lists.title: Los Angeles City College
lists.description:
LACCは、18,000人以上の学生に学位、編入プログラム、証明書など、100を超える職業および専門プログラムを提供するダイナミックで革新的な学習環境を提供します。 2019年、LACCは90周年を迎えます。
LA College Promiseの下で、LAUSD高校とチャータースクールを卒業するすべてのフルタイムの学生に1年間の無料登録を提供しています。また、ハーブアルパート財団のおかげで、音楽専攻の授業料無料、プライベートレッスン、財政援助を提供しています。さらに、私たちの学生は、さまざまな財政援助オプションの恩恵を受けています。
